welcome_message:
Create an AAI self-service analytics application

A governed analytics agent over a neutral, git-versioned semantic layer: curated metric definitions compiled to warehouse SQL, knowledge docs with a runbook loop, provenance footers on every answer, and a two-tier evaluation gate pinned to snapshot data.

project_name.description: Project and bundle name. NOTE: apply template updates deliberately — generated projects record their template version in .aai-template.json
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

application_name.description: Application identifier used in tags, traces, and MLflow experiment names
application_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; start with a letter and do not end with a hyphen.

repository_url.description: Required absolute HTTPS URL of this project's real Git repository; Hub registration rejects example and placeholder URLs
repository_url.pattern_match_failure_message: Use an absolute HTTPS repository URL without credentials, spaces, a query string, or a fragment.

owner_group.description: Non-personal owning group; also stamped as the semantic-model source owner

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog holding the seeded demo star schema

schema.description: Unity Catalog schema for the seeded demo tables the semantic model reads

model_provider.description: Model provider. Choose `databricks` (recommended default: gateway-ready serving endpoint) unless your team already operates its own Foundry resource. Application code only uses the logical name

model_deployment.description: Databricks serving endpoint name or Foundry deployment name

foundry_endpoint.description: Foundry resource endpoint (only asked for Foundry models)

judge_deployment.description: Approved gateway-fronted Databricks serving endpoint used by LLM judges

warehouse_id.description: Serverless SQL warehouse id used by the seed job and the analytics executor; the deploy identity needs CAN USE on it

adversarial_review.description: Run the adversarial review second pass on every answer. Measured tradeoff from production use: higher accuracy at roughly +32% tokens and +72% latency

aai_core_volume.description: Unity Catalog volume holding aai-core wheels

aai_core_pip_source.description: pip-installable aai-core source used only by credential-free CI; MUST resolve to exactly aai_core_version (default: the release git tag; for an internal index use 'aai-core=={{.aai_core_version}}'). Runtime jobs always install the checksum-pinned volume wheel

success_message:
{{.project_name}} created.

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. python3.12 scripts/setup_dev.py     # preflight + isolated setup
  3. make check                          # tests + deterministic offline gate
  4. Review semantics/semantic_model.yml and knowledge/ — curated definitions are the product
  5. Complete the warehouse and schema grants in README.md (external platform process)
  6. databricks bundle deploy -t dev
  7. databricks bundle run release_gate -t dev   # seeds the demo schema, then evaluates

Run `make help` for every target.
